about: The only facts a Short may state. A script line lists the IDs it uses in "facts".
status: confirmed (may be stated), reported (may be stated only in its safe wording), unverified (may not be used).
Only the owner changes a status or gives a new fact as confirmed. Claude adds new facts as unverified and never marks one confirmed on its own.
safe_wording is how to say it on screen and in the voice. also_ok lists other wordings that are just as safe.
Every number a line says or shows must be in the wording of a fact that line lists (for a reported fact: in its safe wording).
source is the main link and more_sources lists the others that say the same.
time_sensitive is true for a fact that can change from day to day (launch-week dates, times and sizes). checked_on is the day it was last read against its sources, as YYYY-MM-DD.

A script that uses a time_sensitive fact checked more than 3 days ago is refused by make_short.py, until the fact is checked again and its checked_on is set to that day (or the owner passes --allow-stale).

facts.claim: GTA 6 update 1.002.000 (about 1 GB) is reportedly already out for PS5.
facts.safe_wording: GTA 6 update 1.002.000 (about 1 GB) is reportedly already out for PS5
also_ok: a GTA 6 update of about 1 GB is reportedly already out for PS5
update 1.002.000 is reportedly already out for PS5
facts.note: Given by the owner on 2026-11-17 as reported. Later the same day the owner narrowed the claim to 'reportedly already out for PS5', made mp1st the main source and tbreak the second, and dropped 'mandatory' and 'must install' from the script, cards and description, because only one outlet says mandatory. Claude read both sources on 2026-11-17. mp1st (13 Nov) supports what is now claimed (version 1.002.000, 1 GB, out for some players, PS5 firmware in the same article). The 'mandatory' evidence, kept here as a record and NOT used: only tbreak (13 Nov) says it. tbreak: 'Rockstar's first GTA 6 update, 1.002.000, is reported as released on PS5 and Xbox Series X on 13 November, and it's marked mandatory' (it credits ComicBook for 'mandatory' and for the Xbox release; Vice and PSINFO cover PS5 only), 'about 1 GB', 'must be installed before you can play on 19 November', and 'Rockstar hasn't published patch notes, and it hasn't said why the download is mandatory'. tbreak's byline says the account is used for 'both Editorial and AI-generated news coverage'. mp1st (13 Nov) confirms the update and the 1 GB ('GTA 6 has been updated to version 1.002.000 with today's 1 GB file donwload') but does NOT say it is mandatory: it says Rockstar 'hasn't announced whether we'll be getting a day-one update or not' and that it is 'unclear whether this is it or if we need to download another one'. Rockstar's own pages say nothing. So the script never says 'mandatory' or 'must install', and never says this is the only update. The advice 'install it before launch night so you're not stuck downloading' is the owner's advice, not a fact. tbreak says PS5 and Xbox Series X releases (Xbox on ComicBook's word alone); only 'for PS5' is claimed.

facts.claim: On PS5, the update reportedly requires firmware (system software) 14.22.00.00, which is the latest PS5 system update.
facts.safe_wording: on PS5, the update reportedly requires the latest PS5 system update

facts.note: Given by the owner on 2026-11-17 as reported; Claude read mp1st (13 Nov) on 2026-11-17: 'This patch also requires firmware version 14.22.00.00, which is what the latest PS5 update is on.' mp1st says 'firmware' and 'the latest PS5 update'; 'system software' and 'system update' are the owner's wording (the same thing, but not mp1st's words). One outlet. 'Latest' was true on 13 Nov and could be passed by a newer PS5 update, which is why it is time_sensitive. Sony's own page was not checked. The spoken line uses 'the latest PS5 system update'; the number 14.22.00.00 is only for a card.

facts.claim: The update reportedly rolled out in waves, first to about half of players (mp1st and tbreak: the rest about 11 hours later).
facts.safe_wording: the update reportedly rolled out in waves, first to about half of players

facts.note: Given by the owner on 2026-11-17 as reported; Claude read both sources on 2026-11-17. mp1st (13 Nov): headline 'It Looks Like Rockstar Might Be Rolling Out Patches in Waves'; 'For now, it's only available for the first 50% of users, and the remaining file will be released after a few hours (11 hours to be exact)'; 'we can't confirm that it will be the case for all updates moving forward'. It credits PlayStation Game Size, who watches PlayStation Store data. tbreak repeats it ('first 50% of users now and the rest about 11 hours later'), so the two are one chain of sourcing, not two. This was the situation on 13 Nov: a script must say it in the past tense and must not suggest the viewer is still waiting for the update. The 11 hours are left out of the wording on purpose.

facts.claim: Kirk's Strangers & Freaks side mission "Search for Tree Effigies" asks you to find and inspect 3 Tree Effigies (trees carved like a figure) in the swamps of Pelican Valley.
facts.safe_wording: there are reportedly three of these hidden out here
also_ok: reportedly, there are three Tree Effigies to find
facts.note: Status given by the owner on 2026-11-20 (reported: fan guides, not Rockstar). PowerPyx's walkthrough, read 2026-11-20: "Find 3 Tree Effigies" and "To solve the quest you need to inspect 3 Tree Effigies in the swamps. You can find them in any order." Its Strangers & Freaks list puts it under Kirk as mission 2 of 3. GTABase says the same (3 carved trees). Used by the hand-made Short effigy-2026-11-20 over the owner's recording Grand Theft Auto VI_20261120175255, in the owner's own words "Game guides say there are three of these hidden out here." (approved 2026-11-20; "game guides say" stands in for "reportedly" there only). Do not name or describe what the next mission in the chain is about (spoiler), and do not call the effigies secret or undiscovered.
